sentences.text: Shri Shyamantak Mani Shukla - Advocate for the appellant  Shri Akshay Namdeo - Govt. Adv. for the State/respondent Heard on I.A. No. 16395 of 2023, which is first application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant Lal Bahadur Singh Gond, arising out of judgment dated 20.02.2023 delivered in Special S.C. No.06/2022 by Special Session Judge (POCSO), Singrouli.

The appellant has been convicted for offence under Sections 450 and 376(3) of the I.P.C. and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 5 years with fine of Rs.2,000/- and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- in the first and second count, under Sections 5L/6 and 5n/6 of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 20 years with fine of Rs.5,000/- in the third and fourth count along with default stipulations.

Learned counsel for the appellant while pressing the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail submits that the present appellant though is cousin brother of the victim but it is a case of false implication because as per prosecution version, the incident took place in the month of May and July, 2021.
The complaint was lodged by the victim in March, 2022 just prior to delivery of child by the victim which took place in April, 2022.

It is contended that the DNA of the child has not matched with the present appellant and there is a conclusive opinion given in the DNA report that present appellant is not biological father of the child.

It is further argued that it is not the case of the prosecution that any other person aided or abetted or participated in the offence of sexual assault on the 2 CRA-3146-2023 victim apart from the present appellant.

As per prosecution version, the present appellant is shown to be the sole person who has committed sexual assault on the victim and the DNA of fetus has not matched with that of the present appellant.
On these grounds, it is prayed to grant benefit of suspension of sentence.
Learned Government Advocate for the State has opposed the application for suspension of sentence on the basis of written objection and prays for rejection of the application.

Considering the aforesaid factual backdrop and without commenting any conclusive opinion on the merits of the case, so also there is bleak possibility of final hearing of this appeal in near future, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of this appellant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, I.A. No. 16395 of 2023 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited), the remaining jail sentence of this appellant is hereby suspended and it is directed that appellant Lal Bahadur Singh Gond be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only )
with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court with a further direction to appear before the concerned trial Court, firstly on 20.05.2025 and also on such further dates as may be fixed by the concerned trial Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
List for final hearing in due course.
